children: Kevin Patrick Marchetti, a 10% owner serving as Co-Executive Chairman, purchased 25,000 shares of Lineage common stock. The shares were acquired at a weighted average price of $39.5022 per share, with purchase prices ranging from $39.37 to $39.69. The total purchase amount reported is $987,555. Following the transaction, Marchetti directly owns 138,690 shares and indirectly owns 155,449,117 shares of Lineage. Mr. Marchetti undertakes to provide, upon request, full information regarding the number of shares purchased at each separate price within the ranges set forth in the footnote and disclaims beneficial ownership of certain indirectly held shares except to the extent of any pecuniary interest therein.
